name: yt-ultimate
description: YT Ultimate desktop app for macOS and Windows
author: YT Ultimate

scripts.test:headless: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.prepare:desktop: npm run backend:build && npm run stage:backend && npm run stage:native && npm run icons:build && npm run build
scripts.prepare:desktop:win: npm run backend:build:win && npm run stage:native:win && npm run icons:build && npm run build
scripts.desktop:build: npm run test:headless && npm run prepare:desktop && npm run build:mac-app && npm run test:packaged && npm run test:packaged:processing
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run test:headless && npm run prepare:desktop && npm run build:mac-app && npm run test:packaged && npm run test:packaged:processing && npm run package:prepackaged && npm run test:artifacts
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run test:headless && npm run prepare:desktop:win && npm run build:win-installer && npm run test:win-package
scripts.release:win: npm run desktop:dist:win && npm run publish:win
scripts.desktop:dist:unsigned: npm run test:headless && npm run prepare:desktop && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build:mac-app && npm run test:packaged && npm run test:packaged:processing && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run package:prepackaged && npm run test:artifacts
